# 0000 — Keep decision records

## Context

Decisions were made in chat and forgotten.

## Decision

We record each decision in this directory.

## Consequences

Every decision has a record a reviewer can cite.

## Enforcement

review-only: a reviewer asks for a record when a change makes a decision.
